evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Speaker supplies the decision as established fact, controlling the informational frame rather than inviting debate.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch; the benefits (performance, cost savings) function as offered rewards that motivate adoption.
Memo header frames the decision as a settled item of information, not an open question.
Quantified performance gain presented as evidence supporting the decision; the gain itself is a benefit offered to motivate alignment.
Fixed deadline imposes temporal pressure on the migration, signaling urgency without explicit coercion.
